findings.claim: The R6 repair introduces a new false sentence into the exact ADR section it was filed against — the ADR says "The first three all scanned MODULES" one line after saying the missing conjunct IS the third — and the same commit's support-matrix calls that conjunct "the fourth", so the two documents disagree on which conjunct the R2 evidence describes.
findings.evidence: specs/decisions/ADR-030-m41-sec10k-inspector-probe.md:136-158 enumerates in this order: (1) endpoint path in no `src/browser/` module but `eval_adapter.py`; (2) host in none but `eval_adapter.py`/`server.py`; (3) no eval case feeds that endpoint through its `input` block; (4) every case with `expect.answer` names the endpoint. Line 151 then reads "The third conjunct is the one that was missing… The first three all scanned MODULES; none looked at what a case FEEDS a run." Under the ADR's own ordering the third IS the new one, so "the first three all scanned MODULES" is false; under the chronological reading it is also false, because the pre-existing citation conjunct scans `evals/**/*.json`, not modules (src/browser/eval_adapter.py:5169-5193). docs/support-matrix.md:319, changed in the same commit d6e6cff, says "4 conjuncts each watched red — the fourth added at PR #58 R2", while src/browser/eval_adapter.py:5195-5199 emits the new key `ground_truth_endpoint_fed_to_the_executor` THIRD in `wrong` and `cases_not_citing_the_ground_truth_endpoint` fourth.
findings.repro: sed -n '136,158p' specs/decisions/ADR-030-m41-sec10k-inspector-probe.md; sed -n '319p' docs/support-matrix.md | grep -o 'the fourth added at PR #58 R2'; source .venv/bin/activate && python3 -c "import src.browser.eval_adapter as ea; print(list(ea._check_ground_truth_endpoint_eval_only()['wrong']))"
findings.acceptance: ADR-030 and support-matrix D30 agree on the ordinal of the input-scan conjunct (matching the `wrong` key order the derived count reads), and the sentence about what the pre-existing conjuncts scanned is true — two scanned `src/browser/` modules and one scanned eval case files, and none of them read a case's `input`. `--suite invariant` and `--suite fast` stay green.

findings.evidence: The ceiling comment is at src/browser/eval_adapter.py:4712-4719, inside `_run_doc_counts_case`.
